title: Mauritania administrative geography and agricultural evidence review

administrative_geography.note: DGAT (Ministry of Interior) reports 15 administrative wilayas and 63 moughataas. Do not confuse these with the 13 elected regional local-government entities described in older decentralisation material. The calculator lookup uses the 15 administrative wilayas.

autumn_2025_rice.caveat: News report reproduces Ministry of Agriculture figures; verify against original ministry tables before calculator use. Regional coverage is only three of 15 wilayas; do not spread national yield to all regions.

current_context.note: FAO GIEWS reports the 2026 coarse-grain harvest underway and irrigated rice harvest expected in November-December 2026; current risk context is not a final yield dataset or farmgate price series.

rice_2024_context.note: AAgWa 2024 district-level rice forecast tables provide prior-year cross-checks for selected departments; forecast values must remain distinct from final observations.

lookup_change: 15 administrative wilayas added to src/_data/calculator/regions.json; lookup only, not activated.
readiness_gaps: Verify original Ministry of Agriculture 2025 autumn campaign tables and rice units/definitions.
Extract crop area, production and yield by crop, season and wilaya.
Obtain dated farmgate prices by crop, wilaya, market and unit; retail prices are not farmgate prices.
Obtain current seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation/energy, labour and machinery costs.
Build wilaya-specific enterprise budgets distinguishing irrigated, rainfed, flood-recession and off-season systems.
Validate MRU currency handling, provenance, calculator mapping and tests.
safeguards: No missing prices or costs invented.
No active country profile or formula changed.
Country remains inactive pending all readiness criteria.
